dialogue.speaker: EMPLOYEE
dialogue.text: Good afternoon, Elaine. Adrian Lim here from the private banking team. I'm calling at the time we arranged. Are you somewhere you can speak privately, or would another time be more convenient?

dialogue.speaker: CLIENT
dialogue.text: Hi Adrian. Now is fine, I'm in my office with the door closed. I've just finished a staff meeting, so we can talk. Please keep it fairly short; there's another appointment coming up.

dialogue.speaker: EMPLOYEE
dialogue.text: Certainly, I'll keep things concise. Let's start with the identification details for our telephone verification.

dialogue.speaker: CLIENT
dialogue.text: My FIN is G seven nine nine nine three zero six E. My date of birth is 7 February 1984.

dialogue.speaker: EMPLOYEE
dialogue.text: Thank you. I've completed that check. You can tell me what you wanted to discuss today, and we'll take it from there.

dialogue.speaker: CLIENT
dialogue.text: The holding I want to reduce is Orion Global Income Fund. I was considering a reduction of 700 units. Also, telephone contact is still easiest for me. Coming down to the branch takes quite a bit of time out of the day.

dialogue.speaker: EMPLOYEE
dialogue.text: Noted on the contact preference. We can arrange calls in advance rather than leave you waiting around. Has your office routine changed much since we last spoke?

dialogue.speaker: CLIENT
dialogue.text: Quite a bit, actually. I'm spending more mornings at home doing the consultancy paperwork, then coming into the office for meetings. The family has been sharing the administrative work more evenly.

dialogue.speaker: EMPLOYEE
dialogue.text: That sounds like a different rhythm. For arranging our calls, should I continue contacting you directly rather than going through the office reception?

dialogue.speaker: CLIENT
dialogue.text: Yes, directly is better. Reception is busy with visiting clients, and messages sometimes reach me after I've left. A scheduled call is easier to fit between meetings.

dialogue.speaker: EMPLOYEE
dialogue.text: All right, I'll note that contact arrangement. Turning to the disclosures now. For Orion Global Income Fund, rising market interest rates can push down the value of the bonds it holds, which can also lower its unit value. Do you understand how rising interest rates can lower the fund's unit value?

dialogue.speaker: CLIENT
dialogue.text: Yes, I understand. If interest rates rise, the bonds can fall in value and bring the fund's unit value down.

dialogue.speaker: EMPLOYEE
dialogue.text: Thank you. I recommend selling Orion Global Income Fund.

dialogue.speaker: CLIENT
dialogue.text: Okay, noted. I want to sell, not add to the holding.

dialogue.speaker: EMPLOYEE
dialogue.text: I'll cover the remaining disclosures now. The transaction charge is 0.25% of the sale proceeds. You could lose some or all of the capital you invested in this fund, and selling may realise a loss. Are you willing to accept investment losses, including a loss realised when reducing this holding?

dialogue.speaker: CLIENT
dialogue.text: Yes, I am willing to accept investment losses, including a realised loss on this reduction.

dialogue.speaker: EMPLOYEE
dialogue.text: Thank you. I'm ready to record the remaining details whenever you're ready.

dialogue.speaker: CLIENT
dialogue.text: Use Singapore dollars as the transaction currency. Set the transaction amount at 150,000. For the order quantity, use the number of units I mentioned earlier. Place it as a limit order, with the limit price at 214.3 Singapore dollars.

dialogue.speaker: EMPLOYEE
dialogue.text: Give me a moment while I finish entering that. I'll stay on the line; there's no need for you to call back.

dialogue.speaker: CLIENT
dialogue.text: No problem. I've still got a little time. It's much easier doing this directly than trying to coordinate a visit around everyone's diary.

dialogue.speaker: EMPLOYEE
dialogue.text: Please confirm your final instruction: sell 700 units of Orion Global Income Fund, with a transaction amount of 150,000 in Singapore dollars, using a limit order at a limit price of 214.3 Singapore dollars. Is that the instruction you want me to execute?

dialogue.speaker: CLIENT
dialogue.text: Yes, I confirm that final instruction exactly as you have stated it. Please proceed.

dialogue.speaker: EMPLOYEE
dialogue.text: Thank you, Elaine. I'll attend to the processing and the usual documentation. That's all I need from you on this call. I'll let you get back to your day.

dialogue.speaker: CLIENT
dialogue.text: Thanks, Adrian. Appreciate you keeping the call brief. Have a good afternoon.
